summary_1line: Urvasi, urged by Indra and Chitrasena and enamored of Arjuna, adorns herself and visits him at night, but he respectfully greets her with modest reverence.

image_candidates.scene_text: Urvasi, adorned with flowers, gold chains, and fragrant sandal paste, walks through the moonlit heavens as celestial beings pause to admire her beauty.
Arjuna, startled in his palace at night, bows with closed eyes before the radiant apsara Urvasi standing at his doorway.
Urvasi prepares herself after bathing, placing garlands and ornaments upon her body while thinking of Arjuna.
